name: Mental Model Theory
axiom: People act on a simplified internal model of a system, not the system itself.
trigger: Users invent their own account of how a feature works, then blame the interface when that account predicts the wrong result.

checklist.text: Name folders, tags, and documents after the objects users already handle in their work.
Update the status view from the same event that performed the action, not from a poll.
Keep storage terms such as rows, records, and foreign keys out of user-facing labels.
Ask users to predict what an action will do before they use it, and record each wrong prediction.

antiPattern.violation: An email client labels a delete action with a database operation, so saving a draft looks like destroying a record.
antiPattern.remediation: Delete moves the message to a Trash folder and states that it stays recoverable for 30 days before purging.

parametricParams.caption: WHERE THE MODEL AND THE SYSTEM PART
